mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order (userName, customerPhone, userAddress, proCount, cost, serialNumber, status, payType, createdBy, creationDate, approvalStatus) VALUES (#{userName}, #{customerPhone}, #{userAddress}, #{proCount}, #{cost}, #{serialNumber}, #{status}, #{payType}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate}, #{approvalStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET approvalStatus = #{status}, modifyDate = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
